en.title: Compare CMSY++ Runs, or CMSY++ with Other Assessments
en.description:
This function draws B/Bmsy and F/Fmsy of the same stocks from several runs of `cmsy_run()`
(e.g. with different start years or priors, a sensitivity analysis) and, optionally, from other
assessments, and gives a table of their last-year values.
en.value: Invisibly, a list with `last_year` (one row per stock and run) and `plots`.

Results of `cmsy_run()`, named or not (e.g. `default = run1, start_1980 = run2`).
arguments.stocks:
Optional stocks to compare: `Stock` identifiers or species, by English or Chinese
FAO name, scientific name or FAO 3-alpha code. Default is NULL, all stocks that ran.
arguments.external:
Optional data frame of other estimates, with columns `Stock`, `Year`, `B_Bmsy`
(and optionally `F_Fmsy`) and `source` (the name shown in the legend, e.g. the agency or
model of the other assessment).
arguments.lang:
The language of the chart text and names: "en" (English), "zh" (Chinese) or
"both" (Chinese and English). Default is NULL, which uses the language set with
`fao_settings()` ("en" unless changed).
arguments.annotations:
The text added to the axis titles and labels: FALSE (default) none, TRUE
all, or any of "title", "subtitle", "caption", "legend" and "labels" (text inside the
chart). The default can be changed for the session with
`options(faofishingreport.cmsy_annotations = TRUE)`.
arguments.pptx:
A logical value. If TRUE, the charts are also saved as editable PowerPoint files in
figures/pptx/cmsy/compare/. Default is FALSE, which can be changed for all functions with
`fao_settings(pptx = TRUE)`.
arguments.silent:
A logical value. If TRUE, the messages on how the stocks were matched are not
printed. Default is FALSE, or the value set with `fao_settings(silent = )`.

zh.title: 比较多次CMSY++运行结果，或与其他评估比较
zh.description: 本函数绘制多次`cmsy_run()`运行（例如采用不同起始年份或先验的敏感性分析）中同一批种群的B/Bmsy和F/Fmsy，也可以加入其他评估的结果，并给出它们最后一年数值的表格。
zh.value: 以不可见方式返回一个列表，包含`last_year`（每个种群和每次运行一行）和`plots`。

`cmsy_run()`的结果，可以命名，也可以不命名（例如`default = run1, start_1980 = run2`）。
arguments.stocks: 要比较的种群（可选）：`Stock`标识，或物种的FAO英文或中文名称、学名或FAO三字母代码。默认为NULL，即所有已运行的种群。
arguments.external: 其他估计结果的数据框（可选），包含`Stock`、`Year`、`B_Bmsy`（可选`F_Fmsy`）和`source`列（`source`为图例中显示的名称，例如另一项评估的机构或模型）。
arguments.lang: 图表文字和名称的语言："en"（英文）、"zh"（中文）或"both"（中英双语）。默认为NULL，即使用`fao_settings()`设置的语言（未更改时为"en"）。
arguments.annotations: 在坐标轴标题和坐标轴标签之外添加的文字：FALSE（默认）不添加，TRUE全部添加，或"title"、"subtitle"、"caption"、"legend"和"labels"（图内文字）中的任意几项。可以用`options(faofishingreport.cmsy_annotations = TRUE)`更改本次R会话的默认值。
arguments.pptx: 逻辑值。为TRUE时，图表还另存为可编辑的PowerPoint文件，保存在figures/pptx/cmsy/compare/。默认为FALSE，可以用`fao_settings(pptx = TRUE)`为所有函数统一更改。
arguments.silent: 逻辑值。为TRUE时不输出种群匹配情况的提示信息。默认为FALSE，或`fao_settings(silent = )`设置的值。
